[[File:Indulgent-class_luxury_starliner_EotEFH.png|thumb|right|250px|An [[Indulgent-class luxury starliner|''Indulgent''-class luxury starliner]]]]
The '''luxury liner''', '''pleasure barge''' or '''luxury starliner''' designation applied to civilian [[Starship/Legends|starships]] over 100 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] long that could carry more than 250 passengers.

The designation included purpose-designed passenger ships, notably the various types denoted by the [[M-class|''M''-class]] designation, but it also included ships using converted [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] hulls.

Luxury liners were regarded as a subtype of the even broader [[Passenger liner/Legends|passenger liner]] classification. They often carried fewer people than the smaller [[Small passenger ship|SSP]] type, offering spacious cabins and impressive recreational areas on longer voyages. However, some luxury liners, like the famous [[Kuari Princess/Legends|''Kuari Princess'']], were sizable vessels with accommodation and facilities for thousands of people.

For self-defense, they were typically armed with [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] and [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]], not military-grade, but sufficient to deter all but the most determined [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]].

Luxury liners provided a wide selection of entertainment geared towards keeping passengers happy. Gourmet meals were served, and travelers had the choice of attending [[Music/Legends|musical]] performances, dancing, [[Hologram/Legends|holo]] shows and even theatrical presentations. The services provided by the liners was not limited to the passengers; the crew were commonly engaged in studying for [[Astrogation/Legends|astrogation]] or ratings exams and were allowed to indulge in their own hobbies including reading, [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]], or even model building.<ref name="RPG">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]'' describes traveling on a luxury liner as costing more money than most make in their lifetimes, but gives a relatively low base price equivalent to buying a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] or used [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]].

The 100-meter minimum size for luxury liners is also the minimum size for [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]].
